title: Preparation draft, version 1
description: draft.json written by the drafter session (docs/PLAN.md section 8, step 2) and read by 'prep build'. Sections are inclusive paragraph ranges inside one spine document; checkpoints carry prompts, reference answers and the paragraphs that support each answer. Cross-reference rules (ids exist, ranges ordered, no overlap, full coverage, support inside the section, plain text) are listed in tools/prep/README.md.
$comment: Unlike checkpoints.schema.json this schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) so a drafter's misspelt member is caught; members starting with 'x_' are allowed for experiments. Patterns end in $(?!\n) for the reason given in checkpoints.schema.json. Lengths are Unicode code points.

excluded.description: Front or back matter left out of every section, as paragraph ranges. May be empty.

checkpoints.description: May be empty. At most one checkpoint per section.

id.description: Same id syntax as checkpoints.json: ASCII letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters.

paragraphRef.description: A reading-stream block as numbered by 'prep extract' (tools/prep/refs.py): 'd' + 1-based spine position (at least 2 digits) + '-p' + 1-based block number in that document (at least 3 digits), for example 'd02-p006'. Never a source XHTML id. Footnote bodies ('dNN-nNNN') cannot be cited.

href.description: A spine document's manifest href, relative to the package (OPF) file, as in checkpoints.json 'chapter_href'.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original EPUB the paragraph references were taken from, 64 lowercase hex digits.

last_paragraph.description: Inclusive. Same document as first_paragraph, not before it.

supporting_paragraphs.description: Paragraphs of the checkpoint's own section that support the answer.
